newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-STRAAL SINKS FEYENOORD'S HOPES OF GOING TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STRAAL SINKS FEYENOORD'S HOPES OF GOING TOP.

text.p: Heerenveen midfielder Roberto Straal dashed Feyenoord 's hopes of going top of the Dutch first division by scoring the only goal of their clash on Friday.
Straal's shot from just outside the box in the 60th minute deflected off the back of Feyenoord defender Bernard Schuiteman to leave goalkeeper Ed de Goey without a chance.
Feyenoord, missing three defenders because of suspension, concentrated mainly on defence until they fell behind. They then failed to create any clearcut chances.
Feyenoord remain second in the table with 35 points from 16 games, one fewer than PSV Eindhoven who have a game in hand.
